meta.run_notes: P3/P4 recorded from one run each (an earlier P4 run crashed on a probe format-string bug and recorded nothing). P1/P2 were re-run to fix probe-script defects; last run recorded. P1b was run twice: the first run used a token without the logon SID and every process died with 0xC0000142, and its tamper control was vacuous (fixed). No product code modified.
defects_found: D1 (refined) recv() maps only 109/232 to EOF; 233 raises. With server CloseHandle ONLY the client reads the full buffered response then gets 109 (handled). 233 arises only after DisconnectNamedPipe; Disconnect without Flush discards unread data (client received 0 of 15 bytes).

D2 usr in (MSYS) openssl fails under write-restricted token (TokenDefaultDacl 0xC0000022, CreateFileMapping error 5); native mingw64 in openssl passes version + Ed25519 genpkey/sign/verify in the allowed scratch dir (needs token with logon SID restricting SID for process init).
O1 server close() FlushFileBuffers blocks while a connected peer withholds reads (4010 ms)
